name: nora
description: A VS Code research canvas for .nora documents.
author: Shlok Khemani

nora.llm.profiles.description: Named Nora LLM profiles. Credentials are stored separately in VS Code SecretStorage.

nora.mcp.directTools.description: Nora MCP tool names that may be called directly.

scripts.build: npm run build:legacy && npm run build:nora
scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run check:purity && npm run check:build && npm run check:native && npm run check:dist
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:performance && npm run test:packaging
scripts.test:unit: node test/unit/hole-id.test.mjs && node test/unit/markdown-renderer.test.mjs && node test/unit/content-blocks.test.mjs && node test/unit/base-url.test.mjs && node test/unit/icons.test.mjs && node test/unit/document-state.test.mjs && node test/unit/pdf-provenance.test.mjs && node test/unit/pdf-selection.test.mjs && node test/unit/pdf-ingest-staging.test.mjs && node test/unit/pdf-import-error.test.mjs && node test/unit/pdf-transcription-capability.test.mjs && node test/unit/provider-registry.test.mjs && node test/unit/preferences-store.test.mjs && node test/unit/model-endpoint.test.mjs && node test/unit/ollama-diagnostics.test.mjs && node test/unit/reducer.test.mjs && node test/unit/lifecycle.test.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: node test/contracts/prompts.test.mjs && node test/contracts/assets.test.mjs && node test/contracts/mcp-markdown-wire.test.mjs && node test/contracts/filesystem-store.test.mjs && node test/contracts/indexeddb-store.test.mjs && node test/contracts/data-boundaries.test.mjs && node test/contracts/artifact-roundtrip.test.mjs && node test/contracts/compatibility-security.test.mjs && node test/contracts/fetch-proxy-worker.test.mjs && node test/contracts/ui-bundle-boundaries.test.mjs && node test/contracts/webview-protocol.test.mjs && node --test test/contracts/nora-archive.test.mjs test/contracts/nora-archive-security.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: node test/integration/pdf-ingestion.test.mjs && node test/integration/pdf-conversion.test.mjs && node test/integration/pdf-node-conversion.test.mjs && node test/integration/pdf-portability-caps.test.mjs && node test/integration/pdf-gc.test.mjs && node test/integration/pdf-precision.test.mjs && node test/integration/pdf-snapshot.test.mjs && node test/integration/image-experience.test.mjs && node test/integration/mermaid-rendering.test.mjs && node test/integration/mcp-rearm.test.mjs && node test/integration/web-ingestion.test.mjs && node test/integration/custom-endpoint.test.mjs && node test/integration/artifact-portability.test.mjs && node test/integration/generation-lifecycle.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e/web-app-setup.test.mjs && node test/e2e/enter-composition.test.mjs && node test/e2e/web-app-learning.test.mjs && node test/e2e/web-app-canvas-sharing.test.mjs && node test/e2e/ui-primitives-browsers.test.mjs && node test/e2e/cross-host-journey.test.mjs && node test/e2e/reducer-browser-parity.test.mjs
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build:nora && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-dependencies --out artifacts/nora.vsix && npm run check:native
